subject: Invoice template variations + portal fallback process

Subject: Invoice template and fallback — first pass

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the vendor onboarding call this morning. I'm attaching our completed onboarding form (BrightWave_onboarding_form.pdf) and a small set of sample invoices (sample_invoices.csv). A couple quick questions as we prepare to send live invoicing next week: 

- Do you require invoices to be submitted via your portal, or is SMTP/email delivery acceptable as a permanent channel?
- If email is allowed, what is the required subject token/format so your AP system can auto-ingest?
- Can we include multiple PO numbers on one invoice, or should we submit one invoice per PO?
- Any preferred CSV headers (line item detail) so we avoid rejects?

We can reformat on our side but want to match Redwood's preferred fields to avoid back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Lucia Gomez
Head of Billing Operations
BrightWave Logistics
Attachments: BrightWave_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), sample_invoices.csv (csv)
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice template and fallback — first pass

Hi Lucia — great to see the forms, thanks. Portal-first is our default for production receipts (better ACKs, idempotency, and PO matching). That said we support email fallback while customers onboard. Details below so you can choose the right path: 

Portal (recommended):
- Upload single invoice files (PDF/CSV) per transaction.
- Required fields in the portal JSON/CSV: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency, supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, PO_number, line_items (description, qty, unit_price, ext_amount).
- Multi-PO: the portal supports a CSV payload with multiple line rows tied to different PO_number values on the same invoice upload; however accounting teams often prefer one PO per invoice for reconciliation. If you must submit multi-PO invoices, include a "PO_concise" column with semicolon-separated PO numbers.

Email fallback (acceptable during onboarding):
- Send to invoices@redwood.com and include a subject token in this format: PO:<PO_NUMBER> | Vendor:<ShortName> (e.g., PO:12345 | Vendor:BrightWave).
- Attach the invoice PDF or CSV; filename should start with the PO token (e.g., PO12345_BW_inv-001.pdf).
- Minimal CSV headers we accept (example attached): invoice_number,invoice_date,currency,total_amount,po_number,line_description,qty,unit_price,ext_amount

I've attached a quick template (invoice_sample_template.csv) and a short ACK token file (ack_token_examples.txt) showing subject and filename examples that our ingestion looks for.

If you plan to stick with email, please run a quick sample (attach one invoice) and we will confirm acceptance and ACK.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_sample_template.csv, ack_token_examples.txt

Thanks — that's really helpful. A couple follow-ups: 

1) VAT / tax handling: in our EU entity invoices we include a tax_rate and tax_amount column. Will those be preserved through the portal ingestion?

2) For email fallback, are we allowed to submit a single ZIP with multiple invoices, or do you require one email per invoice? We sometimes batch 10–20 invoices per email during payroll cycles.

Example of our sample CSV row (copying from sample_invoices.csv):
invoice_number,invoice_date,currency,total_amount,po_number,line_description,qty,unit_price,ext_amount,tax_rate,tax_amount
INV-2025-007,2025-05-15,USD,1520.00,PO-98765,Monthly TMS services,1,1500.00,1500.00,1.333,20.00

If portal supports tax_rate/tax_amount columns that's perfect — we'll map them. For batching, we prefer to send a single ZIP during the first month to reduce email volume; if there's an ingestion path for ZIPs with multiple PDF/CSV entries that's ideal.

— Lucia

Looping in a quick ops note from AP: 
- Tax fields (tax_rate, tax_amount) are supported in both portal and email ingestion; they map to our ledger tax buckets. Please include currency codes and line-level tax where applicable.
- ZIP batching: allowed for onboarding only if the ZIP contains individual invoice files named with the PO token (e.g., PO12345_inv-001.pdf). We ask that you limit batches to 25 files to avoid processing timeouts.
- Exception path: if a file fails ingest we'll send a rejection email with a short error code; please reply with corrected file or use the portal to re-upload (portal gives faster parity).

Next steps: Lucia, if you can send a single sample via email to invoices@redwood.com with subject "PO:98765 | Vendor:BrightWave" and attach one PDF and one CSV row we will process and ACK within one business day. If successful we'll provide the final mapping and advise go-live cadence.

Thanks — Ben
